newsitem.title: USA: US stocks end mixed, Dow up slightly, Nasdaq falls.
newsitem.headline: US stocks end mixed, Dow up slightly, Nasdaq falls.

text.p: U.S. blue chips end slightly higher after relatively quiet session. Dow rises four points to 6932. Nasdaq falls 13 to 1334 as techs endure stiff selling. Networking shares bear brunt of continued pullback in tech group. Treasuries end up modestly, 30-year bond rises 6/32, yielding 6.64 percent.
